officialInventory.summary: The Ministère de l'Environnement et des Ressources Forestières (MERF) is responsible for PAs. Of 83 legally classified PAs (to 1990), a requalification programme (since 1999; décret 2003-237/PR) retained 10-14 priority PAs covering ~578,000 ha. No consolidated official list with legal acts exists in sources seen; records combine the government PoWPA table, NBSAP 2014, 6NR (2018) and the UICN 2008 RAPPAM. A new law on creation and management of PAs was adopted by the National Assembly in August 2026 (promulgation not verified).

areas.name: Parc national Oti-Kéran

legalStatus.text: Erected national park from the Kéran classified forest by décret n° 77-117 du 25 avril 1977 (per UICN 2008); earlier Réserve de chasse de la Kéran created by décret n° 73-139 du 9 juillet 1973.

areas.notes: Part of the Oti-Kéran-Mandouri (OKM) complex. Area after requalification 69,000 ha (initially 163,640 ha; 179,550 ha after 1981-82 extension); PoWPA notes 'Révision en cours'; 6NR (2018) says requalification of OKM was finalised. Ramsar site 1997 and Biosphere Reserve 2011 (PoWPA).

areas.name: Réserve de faune Oti-Mandouri
areas.notes: OKM complex; 110,000 ha after requalification (initially 147,840 ha). Ramsar 1997, Biosphere Reserve 2011 (PoWPA).

areas.name: Parc national Fazao-Malfakassa
areas.designationLabel: Parc national (legally a réserve de faune per UICN 2008)

legalStatus.text: Fazao classified as réserve de faune by arrêté n° 425/51/EF du 15 avril 1951; merged with Malfakassa forest in 1975 and called a national park, but 'aucun décret n'a été pris' (UICN 2008).

areas.notes: 192,000 ha (UICN 2008); PoWPA gives 193,400 ha for the 'Fazao-Malfakassa/Anié' mosaic (Parc national / Réserve forestière). Managed under concession by the Fondation Franz Weber. Largest PA in Togo.

areas.name: Réserve de faune d'Abdoulaye
areas.notes: 30,000 ha; requalification file prepared (PoWPA); conceded to SITEC-Europe in 1999 (UICN 2008).

areas.name: Togodo-Sud
areas.designationLabel: Parc national (requalified 'Réserve de faune de Togodo Sud')

legalStatus.text: Created as forêt classée by arrêté n° 354/EF du 04/07/52; requalified by arrêté n° 004/MERF/CAB du 02-02-2005 with status 'parc national'.

areas.notes: 15,000 ha after requalification. Ramsar site (UICN 2008). PoWPA gives 25,500 ha for Togodo Sud/Nord combined (revised 2002).

areas.name: Togodo-Nord
areas.designationLabel: Zone de gestion des ressources naturelles (ex-Réserve de faune de Togodo Nord)

legalStatus.text: Classified by arrêté n° 174/EF du 26 février 1954 (13,000 ha); requalified by arrêté n° 005/MERF/CAB (dated '02/02', year not given) as zone de gestion des ressources naturelles.

areas.name: Réserve de faune de Galangachi
areas.notes: Oti prefecture; requalified (NBSAP 2014, 'Galengashie'). Area garbled in the UICN 2008 text — left null.

areas.name: Parc national de la Fosse aux Lions
Bayémé
areas.designationLabel: Zone de gestion des ressources naturelles
areas.notes: Zio prefecture; 158 ha after 2005 revision (PoWPA); requalified (NBSAP).

areas.name: Amou-Mono / Tchilla-Monota
areas.designationLabel: Zone de gestion des ressources naturelles / Réserve forestière
areas.notes: Ogou prefecture; 26,400 ha after 2002 revision (PoWPA); requalified (NBSAP).

areas.name: Réserve de faune d'Alédjo
areas.notes: 765 ha; 'Révision en cours' (PoWPA). Also called forêt classée d'Alédjo in the 6NR.

areas.name: Réserve de faune de Djamdè
areas.notes: Has a management plan; buffalo, zebra and wildebeest introduced (6NR).

notEnumerated.reason: Historical total of 83 classified areas (793,000 ha); many encroached and not requalified; no official current list.
Numerous; PoWPA lists the sacred groves of Assévé and Godjinmé (10 ha) as priority, the 6NR names Akissa and Godjinmé; no official list.

gaps: Togo has no marine protected area (6NR: 'le Togo ne dispose pas d’une aire marine protégée').
Requalification instruments (arrêtés/décrets) were seen only as citations in the UICN 2008 report; most current legal acts and post-requalification boundaries are undocumented.
Area figures differ between PoWPA (c. 2012) and UICN 2008; the most recent figure is used and conflicts are noted.
Anié (part of the Fazao-Malfakassa/Anié mosaic) and Balam forest are mentioned but not documented enough to record separately.
The 2026 PA law may lead to reclassification; outcome unknown.
areaKm2 values were converted from hectares (1 km² = 100 ha) where the cited source gives hectares; source figures are quoted in notes where they conflict.
